name: recipebook-workspace
description: Workspace for the recipebook CLI and core library.
author: Rohit Agrawal <https://github.com/agrawal-rohit>

scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run test
scripts.mutate: pnpm --filter recipebook-core run build && stryker run
scripts.mutate:changed: pnpm --filter recipebook-core run build && stryker run --incremental --mutate "packages/*/src/**/*.ts,!packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts,!packages/*/src/**/*.spec.ts"
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm exec biome check --write --no-errors-on-unmatched
scripts.cov: pnpm --filter recipebook-core run build && vitest run --coverage --passWithNoTests
